reconnect.title: Reconnect {{name}}?
reconnect.consequence: The interface goes down and up again; connections through it drop meanwhile
reconnect.appConsequence: The app reaches the router through this interface: it will lose the connection for a few seconds
reconnect.pppoe: PPPoE dials again, so your public IP may change

routes.title: Routes
routes.staticHint: Routes you add here go into the router's network configuration and survive reboots.
routes.gatewayHint: Empty: send straight out of the interface

error.target-invalid: Not a network of this address family
error.gateway-invalid: Not an address of this family
error.gateway-outside: The gateway isn't on this interface's network

routes.consequence: A wrong route can cut off devices or this phone; the router undoes the change after 90 seconds if the app loses contact

result.rolledBack: The change was reverted: the router didn't get a confirmation in time

wireguard.title: WireGuard
wireguard.name: Name
wireguard.addressesHint: For example 10.8.0.1/24; separate several with spaces
wireguard.joinLan: Reach the home network and the internet
wireguard.joinLanHint: Puts the tunnel into the LAN zone
wireguard.openPort: Open the listen port on the WAN
wireguard.openPortHint: Needed for devices outside to connect
wireguard.generatedKeyHint: The router makes the keys and keeps the private key, so the config file and QR code can be exported.
wireguard.ownKeyHint: When the peer made its own keys, enter its public key; the app can't export a config for it then.
wireguard.allowedIpsHint: A phone or laptop gets one /32 address; add the networks behind the peer, if any
wireguard.routeAllowedIps: Add routes for the peer's networks
wireguard.noExport: This peer made its own keys; there is no config to export.
wireguard.consequence: The tunnel restarts; devices using it drop for a few seconds.
wireguard.deleteConsequence: Devices that connect home through it won't be able to.

error.name-invalid: Letters, digits and underscores only, at most 12 characters
error.port-invalid: The port must be between 1 and 65535
error.address-invalid: Invalid address; include the prefix length, for example 10.8.0.1/24
error.address-overlap: This network overlaps an existing one
error.mtu-invalid: The MTU must be between 1280 and 1500

export.title: Export Config
export.hint: Scan the QR code in the WireGuard app on the phone, or import the config file. Both contain the private key: don't share them.
export.privateWan: The WAN address {{ip}} is private; nothing outside can reach it. Use a DDNS name or a public address.

connections.title: Connections
connections.filter: Filter by device, address or port
connections.noAccounting: Byte counts need connection accounting (the RouteLink plugin turns it on).

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.forwardsHint: A port forward makes a device on your network reachable from the internet.
firewall.managedHint: Rules marked App block devices; change them on the device's page.
firewall.advancedHint: This rule has options the app doesn't show ({{options}}); they are kept.
firewall.name: Name

error.port-invalid: A port (1–65535) or a range like 8000-8100
error.range-mismatch: A range must be as long as the external one
error.ip-family: Doesn't match the chosen IP version
error.direction-invalid: A rule needs a zone on at least one side
error.port-needs-tcp-udp: Ports only apply to TCP and UDP

firewall.consequence: The firewall reloads; a wrong rule can block devices or this phone, and the router undoes the change after 90 seconds if the app loses contact
firewall.exposeConsequence: The device becomes reachable from the internet on this port

edit.otherProto: This interface uses {{proto}}, which the app can't edit. Choosing a type below replaces it.
edit.dnsHint: Empty: use the provider's. Separate several with spaces or commas.
edit.dhcpHint: Hands out addresses to devices on the LAN.
edit.startHint: Offset from the network address, e.g. 100 → .100

error.gateway-outside: The gateway must be in the same network
error.dns-invalid: Not a list of IP addresses
error.pool-outside: The pool runs past the end of the network

edit.wanConsequence: The internet connection restarts; if the app loses contact, the router undoes the change after 90 seconds
edit.dhcpConsequence: Devices get addresses from the new pool when they renew

moveConsequences.reconnect: Devices, this phone included, need to reconnect (Wi-Fi off and on) to get an address in the new network
moveConsequences.static: Devices with a fixed address or gateway (an access point, for example) must be changed by hand
moveConsequences.leases: These reserved addresses fall outside the new network: {{list}}
moveConsequences.undo: If the app can't reach the new address within 2 minutes, the router goes back to the old one

edit.movingHint: Turn this phone's Wi-Fi off and on now (or unplug and replug its cable) so it gets an address in the new network. The app confirms the change as soon as it reaches the router.

vlan.title: VLANs
vlan.none: This router has no ports to split into VLANs
vlan.dsaIntro: Ports and VLANs on bridge {{bridge}}. Tap a cell to go from not a member to untagged to tagged.
vlan.switchIntro: Ports and VLANs on switch {{name}}. Tap a cell to go from not a member to untagged to tagged.
vlan.filteringOff: VLAN filtering is off on bridge {{bridge}}: all ports share one network. Switch it on to put ports into different VLANs.
vlan.legend: U untagged (the port's default VLAN) · T tagged · — not a member
vlan.interfacesHint: Set up interfaces, DHCP and firewall zones for a new VLAN in LuCI.
vlan.applyingHint: The network drops for a few seconds. If the app can't reach the router afterwards, the router restores the old settings within 90 seconds.

risk.cut: With a port in the wrong VLAN, devices on it lose the network; so does this phone if it is wired.
risk.rollback: If the app can't reach the router with the new settings, the router restores the old ones within 90 seconds.
risk.downstream: Access points and switches further down need matching VLAN settings, or they drop off.

error.multiple-untagged: Port {{port}} is untagged in more than one VLAN
error.multiple-pvid: Port {{port}} has more than one default VLAN

openvpn.title: OpenVPN
openvpn.intro: Import the .ovpn client profile from your provider and the router connects to that VPN.
openvpn.name: Name
openvpn.consequence: The VPN may take over the router's default route; the network drops for a few seconds. If the router can't be reached afterwards, it undoes the change.
openvpn.statusHint: This OpenWrt release does not let the app read whether a profile runs; only whether it is enabled.

error.name-invalid: Letters, digits and underscores only, at most 32 characters
error.name-taken: A profile with this name exists
error.not-client: This is not a client profile (only client profiles can be imported)
error.missing-files: The profile uses separate certificate or key files ({{files}}); use an .ovpn with them inline
error.needs-login: This profile needs a user name and password
error.read-failed: The file could not be read

ddns.title: Dynamic DNS
ddns.intro: When your public address changes, the domain is pointed at the new one.
ddns.domainHint: The full name to update; for Cloudflare write host@zone
ddns.sourceHint: Pick the WAN interface when the router dials in itself; the web check when it sits behind a modem or another router.
ddns.deleteConsequence: This domain will no longer be updated.
ddns.providerHint: Missing providers appear after installing ddns-scripts-<provider>.

error.url-invalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://
error.unsupported: This provider does not support this address type

sqm.title: SQM Shaping
sqm.intro: Shapes and queues traffic on the router so games and calls stay smooth during downloads (less bufferbloat).
sqm.rateHint: Use 85–95% of the measured speed; 0 leaves that direction unshaped.
sqm.consequence: Shaping takes effect at once; rates set too low slow the connection down.

error.rate-required: Set a rate for at least one direction

adblock.title: Ad Blocking
adblock.both: Both adblock and adblock-fast are installed; this page manages {{name}}.
adblock.sourcesHint: More lists block more and take more memory.
adblock.defaultSource: No list was selected; {{name}} was switched on as well.
adblock.consequence: The router's DNS restarts; name lookups stop for a few seconds.
